children.value: > Fact From Story: On October 27, OFAC imposed a second round of sanctions on key Hamas-linked officials and financial networks.

> Fact From Story: On October 18, the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) announced that it had imposed sanctions on 10 key Hamas operatives and financial facilitators in Gaza and elsewhere including Sudan, Turkey, Algeria, and Qatar.

> > Fact From Story: This action targets members managing assets in a secret Hamas investment portfolio, a Qatar-based financial facilitator with close ties to the Iranian regime, a key Hamas commander, and a Gaza-based virtual currency exchange and its operator.

> > > Fact From Story: To date, the Treasury has targeted nearly 1,000 individuals and entities connected to terrorism and terrorist financing by the Iranian regime and its proxies, including Hamas, Hezbollah, and other Iran-aligned terrorist groups in the region.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Sanctions on financial facilitators disrupts the flow of money.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Sanctions on financial facilitators disrupts the flow of money.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Sanctions are a type of economic penalty.
